description: Geoscience Australia - National Electricity Transmission Lines 2016 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Geoscience Australia. This dataset presents polylines of the national electricity transmission lines in Australia. The transmission lines were digitized in 2011 from the library of imagery held within Geoscience Australia. The transmission lines dataset was revised in December 2016 to reflect the most current version of the AEMO Transmission Network Diagrams. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Geoscience Australia. Its tags are built, infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
